appendAverage_character
declarations.statement:
theorem appendAverage_character {n c s : Nat}
    (Z : BinaryMatrix n (c + s)) (M : BinaryMatrix n c) :
    appendAverage (BinaryMatrixFourier.character Z) M =
      if ((appendBinaryMatrixEquiv n c s).symm Z).2 = 0 then
        BinaryMatrixFourier.character ((appendBinaryMatrixEquiv n c s).symm Z).1 M
      else 0

declarations.name: appendAverage_rankProjection_sum
declarations.statement:
theorem appendAverage_rankProjection_sum {n c s i : Nat}
    (F : BinaryMatrix n (c + s) → Real) (M : BinaryMatrix n c) :
    appendAverage (rankProjection i F) M =
      ∑ Z ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (BinaryMatrix n (c + s))).filter
        (fun Z => Z.rank = i),
        fourierCoeff F Z * appendAverage (BinaryMatrixFourier.character Z) M

declarations.name: uniformMean
declarations.statement:
def uniformMean {n d : ℕ} (f : BinaryMatrix n d → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (∑ M : BinaryMatrix n d, f M) / (Fintype.card (BinaryMatrix n d) : ℝ)

declarations.name: fourierCoeff
rankProjection
declarations.statement:
def rankProjection {n d : ℕ} (i : ℕ)
    (f : BinaryMatrix n d → ℝ) (M : BinaryMatrix n d) : ℝ :=
  ∑ Y ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (BinaryMatrix n d)).filter
      (fun Y => Y.rank = i), fourierCoeff f Y * character Y M

declarations.name: fourierCoeff_rankProjection
declarations.statement:
theorem fourierCoeff_rankProjection {n d i : ℕ}
    (f : BinaryMatrix n d → ℝ) (Z : BinaryMatrix n d) :
    fourierCoeff (rankProjection i f) Z =
      if Z.rank = i then fourierCoeff f Z else 0

declarations.name: fourier_parseval
declarations.statement:
theorem fourier_parseval {n d : ℕ}
    (f : BinaryMatrix n d → ℝ) :
    uniformMean (fun M => f M ^ 2) =
      ∑ Y : BinaryMatrix n d, (fourierCoeff f Y) ^ 2

declarations.name: Spectral47ExactContract
declarations.statement:
def Spectral47ExactContract (sourceHeightCutoff : Real → Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ {n c s h i : Nat} {rho : Real} (F : BinaryMatrix n (c + s) → Real)
    (_basisInv : ∀ (M : BinaryMatrix n (c + s)) (U V : BinaryMatrix (c + s) (c + s)),
      U * V = 1 → V * U = 1 → F (M * U) = F M)
    (_hEven : c + s = 2 * h) (_hi : i ≤ c + s)
    (_hRho : 0 < rho)
    (_hc : (c : Real) = 2 * (1 - rho) * h)
    (_hs : (s : Real) = 2 * rho * h)
    (_hHeight : sourceHeightCutoff rho ≤ h),
    uniformMean (fun M : BinaryMatrix n c =>
      (appendAverage (rankProjection i F) M) ^ 2) ≤
        ((2 : Real) ^ (-(i : Real) * ((s : Real) - 1)) +
          3 * (2 : Real) ^ ((i : Real) - (n : Real))) *
          uniformMean (fun W => (rankProjection i F W) ^ 2)

declarations.name: same_range_matrix_right_orbit
declarations.statement:
theorem same_range_matrix_right_orbit {n d : Nat}
    (M N : BinaryMatrix n d)
    (h : LinearMap.range (Matrix.toLin' M) = LinearMap.range (Matrix.toLin' N)) :
    ∃ U V : BinaryMatrix d d, U * V = 1 ∧ V * U = 1 ∧ N * U = M

declarations.name: basis_invariant_eq_of_same_range
declarations.statement:
theorem basis_invariant_eq_of_same_range {n d : Nat} {A : Type*}
    (F : BinaryMatrix n d → A)
    (hInv : ∀ (M : BinaryMatrix n d) (U V : BinaryMatrix d d),
      U * V = 1 → V * U = 1 → F (M * U) = F M)
    (M N : BinaryMatrix n d)
    (h : LinearMap.range (Matrix.toLin' M) = LinearMap.range (Matrix.toLin' N)) :
    F M = F N

declarations.name: fourierCoeff_mul_right_of_basis_invariant
declarations.statement:
theorem fourierCoeff_mul_right_of_basis_invariant {n d : Nat}
    (F : BinaryMatrix n d → Real)
    (hInv : ∀ (M : BinaryMatrix n d) (U V : BinaryMatrix d d),
      U * V = 1 → V * U = 1 → F (M * U) = F M)
    (Y : BinaryMatrix n d) (U V : BinaryMatrix d d)
    (hUV : U * V = 1) (hVU : V * U = 1) :
    fourierCoeff F (Y * U) = fourierCoeff F Y

declarations.name: fourierCoeff_eq_of_same_range
declarations.statement:
theorem fourierCoeff_eq_of_same_range {n d : Nat}
    (F : BinaryMatrix n d → Real)
    (hInv : ∀ (M : BinaryMatrix n d) (U V : BinaryMatrix d d),
      U * V = 1 → V * U = 1 → F (M * U) = F M)
    (Y Z : BinaryMatrix n d)
    (h : LinearMap.range (Matrix.toLin' Y) = LinearMap.range (Matrix.toLin' Z)) :
    fourierCoeff F Y = fourierCoeff F Z
